description: This file defines the 'Campaigns' class, which extends CRMEntity, managing the 'Campaigns' module in a CRM system. It includes methods for retrieving related entities such as accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, and activities, as well as configuration for list views, custom fields, and relationships between modules.

classes.name: Campaigns
classes.description: Represents the Campaigns module with methods for managing related entities, list views, custom fields, and module relationships in a CRM system.

methods.name: Campaigns
methods.description: Constructor method, initializes logger, database connection, and column fields.

methods.name: get_accounts
methods.description: Retrieves accounts related to the campaign, including custom view options and status management.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts related to the campaign, with options for custom views and status management.

methods.name: get_leads
methods.description: Retrieves leads related to the campaign, with filtering, custom views, and status management.

methods.name: get_opportunities
methods.description: Fetches potential opportunities related to the campaign, including filtering and permissions.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Gets activities (tasks, emails, events) associated with the campaign, with options to add new.

methods.name: add_status_popup
methods.description: Populates HTML for status change popups in related lists.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Generates secondary query parts for reports involving the Campaign module.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation table structures for related modules.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes relationships between a campaign and other entities, such as leads, contacts, or accounts.

methods.name: save_related_module
methods.description: Creates new relationships between a campaign and other modules (Leads, Contacts, Accounts).
